title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices.
latestAction: Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 15 - 8.
summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment requiring the Supreme Court to be composed of nine Justices—one Chief Justice and eight Associate Justices.

actions.text: Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 15 - 8.
